name: PiShockTheSpire2
author: Yahlunna
description:
Unofficial PiShock integration with Slay the Spire 2.

Supports OpenShock shockers too!

Navigate the mod settings to configure your shockers.

This mod is on beta. If you want to give feedback or report a bug, contact @Yahlunna via Discord or leave a message in the mod's Steam Workshop page.
